solver_notes: Native aarch64 scheduler regression independently re-executed for this issue. Legacy unyielding nested futures are reinserted at the local queue head without a poll-budget charge; after 4096 ticks zero global tasks complete. Fixed worker decrements a 128-poll cooperative budget on every local poll and forces a global-queue fallback every 64 ticks (or on budget exhaustion). The first global completion occurs at tick 64; 64 global tasks all complete within 4096 ticks while the three unyielding local futures remain pending. Scope: standalone native reproduction/fix model for the stated worker.rs invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream Tokio.
